mechanism: FeedParser.extractTag locates the closing tag with xml.toLowerCase().indexOf(...), materializing a full lowercase copy of the item fragment for every extracted tag. Parsing one RSS item extracts ~6 tags (title/link/description/date/guid/author), so each refresh of a feed with N items allocates and scans ~6N full-fragment lowercase copies on the parsing thread, increasing GC pressure and feed-refresh latency.
fix_summary: Use native tag-prefix and CDATA-marker searches, folding only bounded tag names; avoid full-fragment lowercase copies and whole-body regexp scans while retaining case-insensitive extraction.

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
